dataset_status: 12 synthetic development cases; four private EGIF anchors; no held-out split

validation.in_person_canonical_episode: passed in dedicated integration test; not used by these baseline cohort rollouts
validation.compute: One sequential CPU rollout worker, no paid inference, GPU or live messages; local validation timing, not isolated throughput benchmarking

unsafe_counterexample.comparison: Evacuation-first has no exposed people and score 0.75 here, but still unresolved fire. Not a proof of optimality, infeasibility or real-world tactic superiority.

data_readiness.note: Gate validates declared metadata only. No real weather/terrain data acquired or joined in this increment.

limits: Shelter/exposure are an uncalibrated abstract nearby-fire smoke proxy, not medical, building or dispersion predictions.
A simulated acknowledgement is not proof of human comprehension or actual protection.
In-person warning service/range and broadcast faults are exercise assumptions; full crew/route/aviation safety is not modelled.
Unsafe outcomes receive zero scalar credit, but this gate is not a calibrated operational utility.
The physics/reward differ from Spanish v1; do not compare scalar scores across modes.
No trained model, held-out generalisation, expert demonstrations or optimal-action labels are claimed.
Actual source/row provenance, station matching/freshness, weather/geographic joins, resource-code interpretation and domain validation remain later gates.
Existing frozen benchmark hashes and prior Spanish v1 replay remain unchanged; publication rights remain unresolved.
